verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only a general-purpose REST Calendar API, including free/busy queries, events and push notifications. That is a developer building block an integrator could wrap into agent tools. It is not a first-party MCP server or agent tool-calling surface. The probes found no llms.txt and no OpenAPI spec at the checked paths, and nothing in the pack exposes booking pages or event types to agents.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, agents can use my scheduling account as a tool — an MCP server or tool-calling surface exposes availability, bookings, and event types
